body.label: 体の層｜腕と前に掛かる髪の下を描き足す
body.prompt: Edit only inside the masked areas. Remove both arms with their navy sleeves, both navy gloved hands, and the long black hair strand that hangs down in front of the jacket on the left. Where they were, continue what was hidden behind them: the navy military uniform jacket (shoulders, sides of the torso, lapel, buttons and belt area), the black hair hanging behind the shoulders, and the control sticks of the cockpit, with the same folds, shading, line art and colors. The body keeps exactly the same pose, size and position. Do not draw new arms, hands or hair strands in front. Keep the face, the cap, the glasses, the hair on the head, the epaulettes and badges, camera, crop, lighting and illustration style identical. Return one single-pilot image.
body.result: 両腕・手袋と、上着の前に垂れる左の髪の房を消して、下の上着・後ろ髪・操縦桿を描き足した絵

face.label: 顔の層｜前髪の下の額と頬を描き足す
face.prompt: Edit only inside the masked areas. Remove the black bangs and the hair strands that fall over the forehead, the left temple and the left cheek under the cap brim. Show the forehead, temple and cheek underneath with the same fair skin tone, soft shading and line art, and keep a natural hairline just under the cap brim. Keep the cap, the eyes, eyebrows, the rimless glasses, the mole, expression, face shape and everything else identical. Return one single-pilot image.
face.result: 前髪を消して、帽子のつばの下の額と左のこめかみ・頬を描き足した絵
